notes.title: Christmas Update - Find the Presents!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121887/a149443a701fb45ec8aa97027212c6f53c83c1b5.png[/img]


Welcome to the Dicember Update of Escape From Ithara, this one kind of a big one, with some Bugfixes, an ingame event and a rework in our steam page!

Thank you for playing our game this 2022 and we're looking foward to seeing you in 2023!

BUG FIXES/UPDATES[b][/b]

In game
[list]
[*] There was a bug that causes the "Heart of Art" doesnt pop up when you complete the Art room, so we did a little update, now the achieve will be complete when you progress in the room.
[/list]
[list]
[*] We added more planks in the doors so its more easy to enter and leave each room.
[/list]
[list]
[*] We increased the general lightning to be more bright
[/list]
[list]
[*] We update the launcher/loading screen, fresh out of the oven!.
[/list]

CHRISTMAS EVENT[b][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121887/dcb9fedcff99a7f115592f6d256402975e3c10b1.jpg[/img]
Find the 7 hidden presents in the game and get the New Steam Achievement "A gift from Ithara".

This event last until Jenuary 5th!

That is all in the December Update! The journey continues in 2023!

notes.title: ESCAPE FROM ITHARA launch on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121887/eb8c95e494de0e5763eb146888865e0dd337eba2.png[/img][b]Escape From Ithara[/b], its our first project as an Indie Company, and everyone can be part of it! Submitting feedback will help us to improve and make the game better!

At this moment, this game launches as an [b]early access,[/b] but there's a few things we are planned to do in the future:

[b]More Rooms, more levels and more depth[/b]
Adding more rooms and secret entries, so the game will last a little bit longer, so we can expand the history behind the temple.

[b]Adapt the game to other platforms[/b]
At this time, this project is only avilable on pc (steam), but we hope with your help we can launch it on Android,Ios and Switch!

[b]Virtual Reality Mode[/b]
The cool thing about first person puzzles, are the possibility of adapting the game into Vr!

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
What's better than explore a temple full of mystery? Playing it with a friend in a coop mode!

¡The Journey awaits!
